hook.text: How many car accidents will happen in a city next year? The Poisson distribution models rare events over set intervals.

buildup.text: Siméon-Denis Poisson published his theory in 1837.

discovery.text: Auto insurers use Poisson to predict claim frequency.

twist.text: The distribution assumes events are independent.

climax.text: Poisson turns rare, random events into predictable patterns.

quiz.question: What does the Poisson distribution model?
options: The probability of rare events occurring in a fixed period
